newsitem.title: USA: ACC Consumer Finance files note offering.
newsitem.headline: ACC Consumer Finance files note offering.

text.p: ACC Consumer Finance Corp filed on Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of $15 million of notes due 2003.
Proceeds from the sale will be contributed to its OFL-A Receivables Corp subsidiary to repay temporarily a subordinated debt facility and for general working capital, the cpmpany said.
Underwriters McDonald & Co. Securities Inc. and J.C. Bradford & Co. have an over-allotment option to buy an additional $2.25 million of the notes, it said.
